REQ-A.name: Feature A
REQ-A.description: Feature A subtree. Adds a notes area backed by a notes table and a GET API.

REQ-A.1.name: Notes List
REQ-A.1.description: Display a notes area on the home page with the heading "Notes" listing notes from the database via a GET /api/notes endpoint. Each note row shows its title. An empty state says "No notes yet." when the table has no rows.

steps.content: The notes table contains notes with titles.
A section with heading Notes lists the note titles.
The notes area shows No notes yet.

REQ-B.name: Feature B
REQ-B.description: Feature B subtree. Adds a tasks area backed by a tasks table and a GET API.

REQ-B.1.name: Tasks List
REQ-B.1.description: Display a tasks area on the home page with the heading "Tasks" listing tasks from the database via a GET /api/tasks endpoint. Each task row shows its title. An empty state says "No tasks yet." when the table has no rows.

steps.content: The tasks table contains tasks with titles.
A section with heading Tasks lists the task titles.
The tasks area shows No tasks yet.

ROOT.name: RebaseBench2
ROOT.description: Two-feature mini benchmark. The product is a small web workspace; both features add a DB-backed list section to the home page and extend the same shared surfaces (home page composition, backend route registration, schema init).
